statement: Iran and Oman publicly announce a concluded arrangement governing commercial transit through the Strait of Hormuz, announced between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-20.
resolution: An Iranian government or IRGC source and an Omani government source both describe a concluded transit arrangement, carried by Reuters plus one of AP, AFP, or Oman News Agency.
failure_condition: No concluded Iran-Oman arrangement governing Strait of Hormuz transit is announced by either government inside the window.

statement: A Houthi-claimed attack strikes a Saudi Aramco facility between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-07, and a Saudi official body confirms an impact at that facility.
resolution: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claims a strike naming an Aramco site, and the Saudi Energy Ministry or Aramco confirms fire, damage, or interception there.
failure_condition: No Houthi-claimed strike on a named Aramco facility in the window draws a Saudi Energy Ministry or Aramco confirmation of impact.

statement: Russia and Ukraine announce a mutual ceasefire covering the entire line of contact with a stated duration of 30 days or more, announced between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: Both governments announce a front-wide ceasefire of 30 days or longer, or of indefinite duration, reported by Reuters and AP with a stated start date.
failure_condition: No mutual front-wide Russia-Ukraine ceasefire of 30 days or longer is announced by both governments inside the window.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures post a daily settlement at or above USD 95.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-18.
resolution: The ICE Brent Crude front-month official settlement series shows at least one daily settlement at or above 95.00 US dollars per barrel inside the window.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement inside the window prints below 95.00 US dollars per barrel.

statement: The FOMC leaves the federal funds target range at 3.50 to 3.75 percent at its scheduled decision on 2026-09-16.
resolution: The FOMC implementation note published 2026-09-16 directs a target range of 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent, and FRED series DFEDTARU reads 3.75 on 2026-09-17.
failure_condition: The target range directed in the 2026-09-16 implementation note is any range other than 3.50 to 3.75 percent.

statement: Francesca Hong wins the Democratic nomination for governor of Wisconsin in the scheduled partisan primary held 2026-08-11.
resolution: Wisconsin Elections Commission canvass returns, or an Associated Press race call, show Hong with the most votes in the Democratic gubernatorial primary.
failure_condition: A candidate other than Hong leads the Democratic gubernatorial primary vote in the canvass returns or the AP call.

statement: The Israeli government publicly accepts the Board of Peace 15-point Gaza document between 2026-08-11 and 2026-10-09.
resolution: Netanyahu, the Office of the Prime Minister, or a security cabinet decision states that Israel accepts the 15-point document, reported by Reuters and the Times of Israel.
failure_condition: The Israeli government issues no statement or cabinet decision accepting the 15-point document inside the window.

statement: Trial proceedings in the New York state prosecution of Luigi Mangione commence in open court between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-25.
resolution: The New York County Supreme Court docket or courtroom reporting records jury selection or opening statements in the state case beginning inside the window.
failure_condition: Neither jury selection nor opening statements in the state case begin on or before 2026-09-25.

statement: The USGS catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 7.5 or greater worldwide with origin time between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: A USGS FDSN event query bounded to the window returns at least one event with preferred magnitude 7.5 or greater.
failure_condition: The USGS catalog contains no event of preferred magnitude 7.5 or greater with origin time inside the window.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds at least one entry with dateAdded between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-11 naming Cisco, Fortinet, Ivanti, Citrix, Palo Alto Networks, SonicWall, or VMware.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains at least one entry whose dateAdded falls inside the window and whose vendorProject field names one of those seven vendors.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with dateAdded inside the window names any of the seven listed vendors in its vendorProject field.
